question: Vietnam released economic reformation policy named 'Doi Moi' from 1986 to 2000. Evaluate the effectiveness of the policy based on the gini score trend of the country in 2 phases: Before 1986 and after 1986
query: SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated) AS average_gini_before, AVG(gini_recalculated) AS average_gini_after FROM (     SELECT year, AVG(gini_recalculated) AS gini_recalculated     FROM country_income     WHERE year < 1986 OR (year >= 1986 AND year <= 2000)     GROUP BY year     UNION ALL     SELECT year, AVG(gini_recalculated) AS gini_recalculated     FROM country_income     WHERE year > 1986 AND year <= 2000     GROUP BY year ) results GROUP BY average_gini_before, average_gini_after
